name: Mandal (Addressed to Tahsildar)
whatItMeans: The administrative mandal of the Tahsildar to whom the application is submitted.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of the Mandal where you are submitting the application.

name: District (Addressed to Tahsildar)
whatItMeans: The district corresponding to the Tahsildar's office.
whatToEnter: Enter the name of your district.

name: Date
whatItMeans: The date on which the application is being filled and submitted.
whatToEnter: Enter the current date in DD / MM / YYYY format.

name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: The full legal name of the person applying for the income certificate.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as per official records.

name: Relation (S/o, D/o, W/o, H/o, F/o, C/o, with Name)
whatItMeans: The name of your relative along with the relationship type.
whatToEnter: Select the relationship type (Son of, Daughter of, etc.) and enter the full name of the relative.

name: Gender
whatItMeans: The gender of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Select either Male or Female.

name: Date of Birth
whatItMeans: The birth date of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your date of birth.

name: Door No
whatItMeans: The house or door number of the applicant's residential address.
whatToEnter: Enter your house or door number.

name: Locality/ Land Mark
whatItMeans: The local area, street, or nearby landmark of the residence.
whatToEnter: Enter your street name, locality, or nearby landmark.

name: District (Address)
whatItMeans: The district where the applicant resides.
whatToEnter: Enter your residential district name.

name: Mandal (Address)
whatItMeans: The mandal where the applicant resides.
whatToEnter: Enter your residential mandal name.

name: Village
whatItMeans: The village or town where the applicant resides.
whatToEnter: Enter your village or town name.

name: Pin code
whatItMeans: The postal PIN code of the residential address.
whatToEnter: Enter the 6-digit postal PIN code.

name: Ration Card No
whatItMeans: The identification number of the applicant's ration card.
whatToEnter: Enter your ration card number if available.

name: Mobile No
whatItMeans: The active mobile phone number of the applicant for communication.
whatToEnter: Enter your 10-digit mobile number.

name: AADHAAR NO
whatItMeans: The unique 12-digit Aadhaar identification number of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number.

name: Income from Land and Buildings
whatItMeans: The monetary income earned from lands and real estate properties.
whatToEnter: Enter the total annual income earned from land and buildings in Rupees.

name: By Business
whatItMeans: The monetary income earned from running a business.
whatToEnter: Enter the total annual income earned from business in Rupees.

name: Total Income of husband and Wife
whatItMeans: The combined income of both the husband and wife.
whatToEnter: Enter the combined total income of husband and wife in Rupees.

name: Daily wage Earner
whatItMeans: The monetary income earned through daily wage work.
whatToEnter: Enter the total income earned as a daily wage earner in Rupees.

name: Income from Others Source’s
whatItMeans: Any other miscellaneous income not covered by the above categories.
whatToEnter: Enter the total income from any other sources in Rupees.

name: Total
whatItMeans: The sum of all income sources mentioned in the form.
whatToEnter: Enter the final calculated sum of all income sources in Rupees.

name: Purpose of Certificate
whatItMeans: The specific reason or objective for which the income certificate is required.
whatToEnter: Enter the reason for applying (e.g., scholarship, welfare scheme).

name: Parents Signature
whatItMeans: The physical signature of the applicant's parent.
whatToEnter: Have your parent sign in the designated space if required.

name: Signature of the Applicant
whatItMeans: The physical signature of the person applying for the certificate.
whatToEnter: Sign your name to confirm the details provided are correct.
